Sniper City updates

Patch notes for Sniper City, newest first.

19 November 2026

New map: Loop City

  • A second map, built on the inside of a ring 640 metres round. Look up and the far side of the city hangs over you. Switch maps with the MAP button on the title screen. About the maps.
  • Loop City works online. The room host can change the map in the lobby.
  • Breakable walls on Loop City rooftops: two rifle rounds or a rocket bring a section down.
  • Teleport doors on both maps. Walk in and you come out somewhere else. A rare trip puts you on the angel’s crown until you are shot.

Weapon

  • The menu has a WEAPON screen with three tabs: PARTS, SCOPE and SKINS. Your rifle sits on a bench in 3D, with its stats beside it. The STORE button is gone: nothing was ever for sale.
  • GRAPHITE, a free black and red rifle skin.
  • Rifle parts: choose a barrel, magazine, stock and ammunition pouch. Every part gives something and takes something, and all are free. They work solo and online.
  • Ten scopes, from the plain cross to glass that reads the range, brackets a sniper and gives a bearing. Zoom steps from 3× to 10×, seven reticle colours. All free.

The city

  • New rain: drops fall as streaks, puddles mirror the city, and rings spread where drops land. It rains on Loop City now too.
  • New colour: Hong Kong Rooftops is a blue storm night with warm lit windows and lightning. Loop City is a green rain haze.
  • New metal ladders on every climb on both maps.
  • The title screen is now a rooftop safehouse: your sniper keeps watch from a ledge, with a kit crate, a surveillance monitor and a radio, and the angel in view.

18 November 2026

Online

  • The RPG-7 works in online matches: two rockets, and the server decides where each one bursts. Your own blast is not credited to you.

17 November 2026

Combat

  • The hammer now takes half a life per hit from any side, so it never kills in one swing, and you get 5 swings a match. Room hosts can switch it off.
  • New knife: a quick stab for a quarter of a life, with no limit. Middle mouse button or J; on phones it is in the bolt menu.
  • New smoke bomb: one a life, hold Y to aim and release to throw. AI snipers cannot see through the cloud.
  • Other players now see the weapon in your hands: rifle, sidearm, hammer or knife.

Fixes

  • The view no longer keeps turning by itself when the mouse leaves the game window.
  • Online: shots no longer stop registering after a reconnect.
  • Online: shots at a sniper who is leaning or playing dead now land where you see them.

Controls

  • Phones: drag up or down on the zoom button for smooth zoom between 4× and 8×.

15 November 2026

New in solo matches

  • A 10-second match briefing with the rules. It can be skipped.
  • Half-time air drop with the AWM: three bullets, one shot kills, shots pass through walls.
  • Scope vision: 30 seconds of thermal and night vision per match.
  • RPG-7 with two rockets.
  • Three dogs tied on rooftops that you can unleash and send after an enemy.
  • A once-per-match prayer to the angel.
  • Lucifer, earned with three gun kills in a row.
  • Drifting fog banks and a red glint from snipers aiming at you.

Combat

  • Rifle bullets in solo matches now take time to arrive and drop over distance. The scope shows marks for 50, 100 and 150 metres.
  • Kill cam: when another sniper kills you, the view cuts to them and looks back down the shot.
  • Aim assist on touch screens gently pulls toward a visible enemy while you aim. It can be turned off on the title screen.

The city

  • Neon signs in red and white hang off the buildings.
  • Windows in the far towers switch on and off, and their light now shows through the fog.
  • Air-conditioner units with turning fans, antennas with red warning lamps, and washing on poles and lines.
  • Headlights and tail lights move along the streets below, and aircraft cross overhead.

Controls

  • New phone layout: fixed joystick, sprint lock, weapon slots and a swipe menu for the decoy and playing dead.
  • New first-person arms and a Desert Eagle sidearm.
  • Every on-screen button can be moved, resized or hidden, including the Lucifer, dog and skip buttons.

Fixes

  • Pausing no longer resets the air drop, dogs, rockets, prayer or scope vision.
  • Rifle ammunition is restored correctly after the AWM.
  • Dogs follow the rooftops, jumps, ladders and cables. They no longer run through walls.
  • Rockets hit reliably at low frame rates.
  • The game's files now load when you press Play, so the page opens faster.
  • Solo-only models are downloaded only when a solo match starts.
